fixes.explanation: Not a burden, friend. The writer says, “So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.” (Hebrews 10:35). Notice what comes right after that. The very next verse says, “You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.” (Hebrews 10:36). So the confidence isn't weight to drop. It's what carries you to the promise.
